name: Age calculator
title: Age Calculator: Exact Age in Years, Months and Days
description: Find an exact age in years, months and days, plus total weeks and days, the weekday of birth and how long until the next birthday. Works for any date.
summary: Exact age in years, months and days, and the countdown to the next birthday.
howTo: The age is worked out for today. Change Age on to find an age on any other date, past or future, such as a school start date or a deadline.
Read the exact age, the totals in months, weeks and days, and the countdown to the next birthday.

faq.q: How is the exact age calculated?
faq.a: By counting whole years from the date of birth, then whole months, then the days left over, just as you'd count on a calendar. Someone born on 15 June 1990 is 36 years, 4 months and 26 days old on 10 November 2026.

faq.q: What if I was born on 29 February?
faq.a: In years without a 29 February, this calculator counts your birthday as 28 February. Some countries' laws use 1 March instead for legal age, so check if it matters for an official form.

faq.q: Can I work out an age on a past or future date?
faq.a: Yes. Change Age on to any date. That's handy for school or sports cut-off dates, insurance or retirement planning.

faq.q: Is my date of birth saved anywhere?
faq.a: No. It's calculated in your browser and kept only while this tab is open, so a refresh doesn't clear it. Nothing is sent to a server.
